sloka: विशुद्धा त्रिषु लोकेषु मैथिली जनकात्मजा ।न हि हातुमियं शक्या कीर्तिरात्मवता यथा ।। ६.१२१.२१ ।।
transliteration: viśuddhā triṣu lokeṣu maithilī janakātmajā ।na hi hātumiyaṁ śakyā kīrtirātmavatā yathā ।। 6.121.21 ।।

translations.english: "You are worship worthy of the world and loving people advising me in this way. Your words of good advice are good to all and for me. I will certainly follow."
